result.summary: The pedestrian environment is a narrow residential street with sidewalks that are significantly obstructed by utility poles and lack formal crossing infrastructure. There are no marked crosswalks or curb ramps at the visible intersection, and parked vehicles further limit visibility and accessibility for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Utility pole obstruction
hazards.description: A large wooden utility pole is situated directly in the pedestrian path on the sidewalk, forcing users to step into the roadway or narrow gaps.

hazards.name: Unmarked crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks any painted crosswalks, failing to designate a safe space for pedestrians to cross.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the corner and the utility pole block the view between drivers and pedestrians at the crossing point.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-style painted crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and alert drivers to crossing locations.

interventions.title: Curb ramps
interventions.description: Install ADA-compliant curb ramps at all corners of the intersection to ensure accessibility for all users.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20 feet of the intersection to improve sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban street with a continuous sidewalk on one side but lacks any formal pedestrian crossing infrastructure or traffic control devices. The roadway pavement is in poor condition with significant cracking, and the environment is bordered by industrial-style fencing and utility poles.

hazards.name: Degraded Roadway Surface
hazards.description: Extensive cracking and wear on the asphalt surface create uneven footing and potential hazards for all road users.

hazards.name: Absence of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no visible marked crosswalks or pedestrian warning signs, increasing risk for anyone attempting to cross the street.

interventions.title: Roadway Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the street to provide a smooth, safe travel way for vehicles and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Install High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crossings with high-visibility paint to define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Streetscape Greening
interventions.description: Introduce street trees and planters to create a more inviting and protective buffer for pedestrians.

result.summary: The environment is highly hostile to pedestrians, completely lacking sidewalks, crosswalks, or any form of physical separation from vehicular traffic. The roadway is in poor condition with significant cracking and is bordered by an unpaved shoulder cluttered with trailers and debris.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: Total absence of sidewalks forces pedestrians to walk in the roadway with vehicular traffic.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Significant cracking and potholes in the asphalt create trip hazards and uneven surfaces.

hazards.name: Shoulder Obstructions
hazards.description: Trailers, vehicles, and debris on the unpaved shoulder block potential walking paths and limit sight lines.

interventions.description: Install a continuous, paved sidewalk to provide a dedicated and safe space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Add street light poles to improve visibility and safety for all road users during low-light conditions.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
